raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated multiple engagements at Palembang (treating a later related action on 24 February as part of the same battle) and ignored the cited source indicating the Battle of Palembang occurred 13–15 February 1942; thus the correct end date, 15 February 1942, was replaced with 24 February 1942.
